items.notes: Covers tenant-scoped routing, credentials, quotas and shared-vs-dedicated pools; does not address shared-to-dedicated storage migration coordination steps.
States same-key/different-intent reuse must be rejected and describes binding a request key to immutable parameters.
Directly separates agreed scheduler state from the external effect; consensus on a log does not prove an RPC or side effect occurred.
Supports test reasoning by separating HTTP method semantics from business-effect deduplication, but does not address duplicate requests after key expiry.
Compares logical dumps, physical backups and WAL replay; does not distinguish RPO from RTO.
Notes replicas can lag and continuous replication may reproduce state faithfully; supports but does not directly discuss promoting a replica to recover a deletion.
Frames PITR and warns a WAL archive alone is not a working restore procedure, but the excerpt does not enumerate the required artifacts.
Diagnostic experiment table for CPU, pool, GC and memory hypotheses; unrelated to fan-out threshold probability under independent identical latencies.
Worked retain/hedge/split decision treats hedging as an option under load but does not state when hedges themselves add overload.
Directly contrasts closed and open models and names the slowed-arrival/coordinated-omission effect of closed feedback.
